name: val-town
title: Val Town
description: Browse your vals, read their logs and traces, and turn them into tools for Raycast AI
author: KevinBatdorf

commands.name: search-vals
commands.title: Search Vals
commands.subtitle: Val Town
commands.description: Browse your vals, their files, logs, traces, history, SQLite and blobs.

commands.name: manage-tools
commands.title: Manage Tools
commands.subtitle: Val Town
commands.description: Review the vals you tagged as tools and the specs Raycast AI calls them with.

commands.name: errors
commands.title: Errors
commands.subtitle: Val Town
commands.description: Watch chosen val files and notify when a new execution fails.

tools.name: list-tools
tools.title: List Val Town Tools
tools.description: The user's callable Val Town tools and the arguments each takes. Call this before running any val of theirs.

tools.name: execute-tool
tools.title: Execute Val Town Tool
tools.description: Run one of the user's Val Town tools. Take the name and arguments from list-tools; never guess them.

tools.name: get-val-info
tools.title: Get Val Town Val Info
tools.description: Read a val's files and source. Only when the source itself matters, such as debugging a failing tool.

tools.name: load-skill
tools.title: Load Val Town Skill
tools.description: Load one of the user's own Val Town skills: a guide naming which vals to call and in what order.

ai.instructions: Call list-tools for the user's tools and their arguments, then execute-tool to run one. Never invent a name or argument. For a named skill, load-skill first.
